Name: Pause Walder Troll
Information:
**Pause Walder**

Pause Walders are cursed plants that were born from a misguided attempt to animate plants to become guardians and attack dogs. They were originally created in an attempt to protect the Deep Pause Temple, but they went rogue and developed a thirst for blood. The first generation of Pause Walders were destroyed, but their seeds caused other plants to mutate and spread, leading to them appearing across Somnus Domina.

**Body of Twisting Roots**

The body of the Pause Walder is made of freeforming roots that can reconfigure themselves into various forms, and so when they are inactive they can appear to be basic, uninteresting plant matter. They generally remain inactive and inert, unless the possibility of drinking mortal blood presents itself, or they risk starving.

**Walder Trolls**

A Pause Walder Troll is a great, powerful Pause Walder that is formed from uncountable smaller iterations coming together to fuse into a creature that could be considered a tree compared to the bushes they usually are. A Walder Troll will begin as a huge cocoon that consumes great amounts of blood harvested by regular Walders, and after several months of incubation will emerge as a towering, hungry beast. Walder Trolls are more ambitious than their kin, and will go on killing sprees in towns, hunt larger prey, and try to consume entire communities. A final form of Walder evolution may exist beyond the Walder Troll, if many Trolls came together in a similar way.

traits.name: Bloodhound
traits.description: The walder can see creatures within twice as far as its blindsight range as long as they have blood, even if they are invisible or hidden. Similarly, it is blinded to creatures with no blood, even within its blindsight.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While it remains motionless, the walder is indistinguishable from a mass of bark or tree matter.

traits.name: Shifting Mass
traits.description: The walder can shift its body to be able to fit through any space that would fit a Medium or larger creature with squeezing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The walder makes two Brambling Strikes.

actions.name: Bramble Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller they are grappled (escape DC 17). The walder can produce additional appendages to grapple up to four creatures this way without losing use of its limbs.

actions.name: Bloodletting Thorns
actions.description: Each creature the walder is grappling must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) piercing damage on a failure, and the walder regains hit points equal to half the damage taken by its targets. Hit points gained this way that exceed its maximum hit points are gained as temporary hit points instead.

bonus_actions.name: Feast
bonus_actions.description: The walder targets any number of dead bodies around it within reach of its Bramble Strike, and absorbs them into itself. The bodies are destroyed, and the walder gains temporary hit points for each based on their size: 14 (3d8) per Medium creature, plus 9 (2d8) for each size larger they are.
